name: hypr-mac-theme
title: Omarchy Themes
description: Switch between Omarchy themes and install them from git, with hypr-mac's theme script
author: ryanahayden

commands.name: switch-theme
commands.title: Switch Theme
commands.description: Pick an installed Omarchy theme for Ghostty, nvim, the window border and light/dark mode

commands.name: set-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Wallpaper
commands.description: Pick one of the current theme's wallpapers or yours, or add a new one

commands.name: install-theme
commands.title: Install Theme
commands.description: Clone an Omarchy theme from a git repo and switch to it
